title: Crystal River Boat Tours
specs: Spot manatees, dolphins, alligators, Great Blue Herons, Ospreys, Bald Eagles
Pass by Crystal River State Archaeological site with ancient pre-Columbian burial mounds
Wildlife Boat Tour minimum 2 guests, maximum 6 guests
includes: Guided tour by USCG Master Captain Wayne Bodley
blurb: Guests embark on a 2-hour guided boat tour aboard a 20-foot pontoon boat through Crystal River and King’s Bay. They can spot wildlife including manatees, dolphins, alligators, and native birds while learning about the area's history. Tours also include visits past the Crystal River State Archaeological site with ancient burial mounds.
extraNote: Ash Scattering Ceremony requires scheduling by phone · Option to add up to 2 additional guests for Sunset Cruise at $50 each

quotes.text: Captain Wayne’s Crystal River boat tour was a great experience. He was knowledgeable about the area’s wildlife and local history, providing interesting information. We had a good opportunity to see manatees and other local species. The boat was in good condition, and the tour was well-organized. It was a relaxing, enjoyable way to experience Crystal River, and I’d recommend it to others.”Minda H.

If there were 6 stars I would give it to Captain Wayne. Thanks for a great day on the water and spectacular wildlife. If you want a small group of friends – up to six on your own guided boat tour this is the person to contact. Very knowledgeable of the area and lots of insights. You’ll have a chance to get close up with dolphins, manatees and lots of wildlife. We’ll definitely be back.”Sandra S.

quotes.author: Mark & Sarah
quotes.text: We had a Fantastic Crystal River Cruise today with Captain Wayne. A beautiful day spending a couple of hours cruising the water. So good to see the Manatee in their natural habitat, Mums with calves and other wildlife all around. Don’t think about it Book it….. Thank you Captain Wayne for a very informative trip and making the day a great memory for us both. 😀☀️”Mark & Sarah

Great experience seeing manatees in the wild at Crystal River. A wealth of knowledge and a relaxing pace on the water made it enjoyable as we could see more than we could have ever imagined along our journey. 5 star experience without question, I would highly recommend anyone booking a tour with Crystal River Boat Tours!”David M.

Went out today with my husband and friend. Wayne was very professional, informative and funny. It was a very relaxing tour, saw some manatees and other wildlife. Very clean and comfortable pontoon. I would recommend to anyone interested. If I ever come back to Florida, I will be visiting Captain Wayne again!”Kelly S.
